Name: Old Ancient Fruit Price (BROKEN)
Author: RizadonRekkuza
Description:
Simply changes the value of Ancient Fruits from 550g to 750g, their original value prior to 1.1. As they are a time consuming crop to multiply, I felt that their new selling price of 550g was not reflective of the effort that goes into cultivating them. This change in value should also be affecting wine and jam made out of Ancient Fruit.

NO LONGER WORKS. No idea when I'll fix it, so feel free to do it if you feel like it.

Manifest.Name: Old Ancient Fruit Price
Manifest.Description: Reverts the selling price of Ancient Fruit back to 750g.
